scripts.text:
[Garrison]
You're not a gunslinger.
You're distracting me from my work. Go on.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
你不是神枪手。
别打扰我工作，快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
My name is Garrison. I'm a master in crafting guns.
The gun I make is also called the Garrison. I named it that because I think the Garrison is as cool and perfect as myself.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
我叫加里森，是制造枪械的大师。
我制造的枪也被称为“加里森”。我之所以这么命名，是因为我觉得“加里森”和我一样酷，一样完美。

[Garrison]

[加里森]
何不向我定制一把“加里森”呢？

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
My name is Garrison. I'm a master in crafting guns.
The gun I make is also called the Garrison. I named it that because I think the Garrison is as cool and perfect as myself.

我叫加里森，是制造枪械的大师。

[Garrison]
Are you here to commission a Garrison from me?

[加里森]
你是来找我定制“加里森”的吗？

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Hmm~ What's going on?
Are you here because you need a weapon?

[加里森]
嗯~ 怎么了？
你是因为需要武器才来的吗？

[Garrison]
Oh~ Welcome
Everyone needs me~!
It just proves that my gun, the Garrison, is the best of the best.
So, are you going to ask me to make one now?

[加里森]
哦~ 欢迎。
大家都需要我~！
这正说明我的枪“加里森”是最好中的最好。
那么，你现在要让我做一把吗？

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Hmm~ You look like you're wandering around without a mission.
If you've got the time, will you do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
嗯~ 你看起来像是在漫无目的地闲逛。
如果你有时间的话，能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is it?

[Garrison]
Mmm~ Well, I had actually received a letter recently stating that there are many defective makes of a gun I created called the Six Shooter.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
嗯~ 是这样的，我最近收到了一封信，说有很多我制造的名为“六轮发手枪”的枪存在缺陷。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
I'm a perfectionist, but due to my old age, my eyes are growing dark, and I think I may have sold defective Six Shooters.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
我是个完美主义者，但由于年老，我的视力逐渐下降，我想我可能卖出了有缺陷的“六轮发手枪”。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
So what I'm trying to say is, I'm hoping someone will find me spare parts which I can use to replace defective parts in the detective Six Shooters.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
所以我想说的是，我希望有人能帮我找到备用零件，以便替换那些有缺陷的“六轮发手枪”中的故障部件。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
If you help me, I'll put a slot in that Garrison you're holding right now.
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
如果你帮了我，我会在你手里拿的那把“加里森”上开一个插槽。
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Just so you know, if I slot your Garrison, any current refine points or slotted cards will disappear. Decide carefully.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
提醒你一下，如果我在你的“加里森”上开插槽，当前的强化点数或镶嵌的卡片将会消失。请慎重考虑。

scripts.text: I don't like the sound of this.
scripts.translation: 听起来不太妙。

scripts.text: Ok, I'll try it out.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我试试。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Hmm, I see.
I understand.
I guess I'll look for a different man.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
嗯，我明白了。
我理解。
看来我得找别的男子了。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Oh, would you?
I'm so thankful.
These are the materials I need to make spare parts...
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
哦，你愿意吗？
太感谢了。
这些是我制造备用零件所需的材料...

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
10 Steel, 1 Elunium, 10 Emveretarcon, 30 Coal, and 10 Rusty Screws.
I need this exact amount. Don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
10个钢，1个铝，10个强化武器金属-级数二，30个煤炭，以及10个生锈的螺丝。
我需要这个确切的数量。别忘了。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Hmm... Come and see me later.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
嗯... 稍后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
10 Steel, 1 Elunium, 10 Emveretarcon, 30 Coal, and 10 Rusty Screws.
Don't forget -- the amount has to be exact.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
10个钢，1个铝，10个强化武器金属-级数二，30个煤炭，以及10个生锈的螺丝。
别忘了——数量必须完全准确。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Oh~ You're back with what I need~
I'm so grateful.
Oh.. there's another favor I need to have done. Err...
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
哦~ 你带着我需要的东西回来了~
太感谢你了。
啊...还有件事想麻烦你一下。那个...

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
I need to deliver the spare parts once I make them to another person, but I've got so much work to do around here.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
零件做好后，我需要把它们交给另一个人，但我这里还有好多工作要做。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Sorry to ask, but I was hoping you can deliver what I make out of these materials to the next person.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
不好意思，我想请你把我用这些材料做好的东西交给下一个人。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
While you are on delivery, I will make preparations to slot your Garrison, as promised.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
在你送货的时候，我会按照承诺，开始准备给你的加里森进行改装。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
-Hmm, I don't want to do it, but I'll do it anyway.-
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
-嗯，虽然不想做，但还是会做的。-

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Oh, thanks a lot.
Then deliver this to a person called Ravey. He lives in the slums of Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
哦，非常感谢。
那就请把这个交给一个叫拉维的人。他住在里希塔乐镇的贫民窟。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You receive the delivery goods from Garrison.
Let's deliver them to a person named Ravey, who lives in the slums of Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你从加里森那里收到了待送物品。
让我们把它们交给住在里希塔乐镇贫民窟的拉维吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You receive the delivery goods from Garrison.
Let's deliver them to a person named Ravey, who lives in the slums of Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你从加里森那里收到了待送物品。
让我们把它们交给住在里希塔乐镇贫民窟的拉维吧。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Oh~ How was your trip?
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
哦~ 旅途如何？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Gyah~
I nearly died!!!
That man tried to attack me when he saw me. I barely escaped death!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀~
我差点就死了！！！
那个男子一看到我就想攻击我。我好不容易才逃过一劫！

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Ahh~ Oh no.
I had no idea the person who sent the letter was actually plotting to assassinate me. He was probably sent by one of our enemy guilds...
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
啊~ 糟糕。
我完全没想到寄信的人竟然在策划暗杀我。他可能是被我们敌对的公会派来的...

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
It looks like I've sent you unintentionally on a very dangerous mission.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
看来我不小心让你去执行了一个非常危险的任务。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
I'm so sorry.
You may also know, but there's bad guys plotting to attack the Professor and the Gunslinger Guild all over the place.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
非常抱歉。
你可能也知道了，到处都有坏人正在策划攻击智者和神枪手公会。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Consider this a part of your training as an Gunslinger.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
就把这次经历当作你作为神枪手的一次训练吧。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
I'm sorry about what happened.
But, as promised, I will slot your Garrison ...
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
对于发生的事我很抱歉。
但是，按照承诺，我会给你的加里森进行改装...

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Huh? Sigh.
Did you sell off your gun while you were gone?
I said I'd slot your gun, but I never said I'd slot a gun that isn't here.
Go and get your Garrison and then get back to me.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
咦？叹气。
你不在的时候把枪卖掉了？
我说的是给你的枪进行改装，但我没说会给一把不在这里的枪改装。
去把你的加里森拿回来，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Let's see~
*tonk* *tonk* *thump* *whump*
Here is your modified
Garrison.
Please use it well.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
让我看看~
*哐* *哐* *咚* *噗*
这是改装好的
加里森。
请好好使用它。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Go and get your Garrison and then get back to me.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
去把你的加里森拿回来，然后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Ah, there it is.
Here is your modified
Garrison.
Do use it well.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
啊，在这里。
这是改装好的
加里森。
请好好使用它。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Hmm~ You're back again~
What's the matter?
Did you come back because you need a weapon?
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
嗯~ 你又回来了~
怎么了？
是因为需要武器才回来的吗？
你需要什么？

20 Rusty Screws, and
there's a fee of 30,000 Zeny.
Well, do you want one?.

制造加里森，我需要...
50个钢铁，3个铝，
1个神之金属，50个煤炭，
20个生锈的螺丝，
还有30,000 Zeny的手续费。
那么，你要做一个吗？

scripts.text: Maybe later.

scripts.text: Yes, make it for me immediately.
scripts.translation: 是的，马上给我做。

scripts.text: Cancel

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
Hmmm~ I got worked up for nothing~
Think about it. Come see me if you decide.
scripts.translation:
[加里森]
嗯~ 白高兴一场~
好好考虑一下。决定了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Garrison]
You didn't bring enough materials

50 Steel, 3 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 50 Coal,
50 Rusty Screws,
and there's a fee of 30,000 Zeny

你带来的材料不够。

1个神之金属，50个煤炭，

别忘了。

scripts.text:

You need more Zeny~!

你的Zeny不够~！
Zeny更多点！！

There's no room in your inventory

再来找我。

如果还需要，再来找我~

10个生锈的螺丝，以及

You've got me worked up for nothing~
Get back to me when you've made up your mind.

你让我白高兴一场~
想好了再来找我。

scripts.text:

You didn't bring enough materials

10 Steel, 1 Elunium,

10 Rusty Screws, and
1 Garrison.
Don't forget.

你带来的材料不够。

10个钢铁，1个铝，
10个强化武器金属-级数二，30个煤炭，

1个加里森。
别忘了。

嗯，看起来材料和Zeny的数量都正确。

如果还需要，再来找我~

Ugh...
Err.. Err..

scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
你好！
我被任命为新的神枪手武器创造者。我叫英格丽德。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
However, you don't seem to be a member of the Gunslinger Guild, so I can't help you with anything. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
不过，你似乎不是神枪手公会的成员，所以我无法为你提供帮助。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
How are you!
I've been appointed the new Gunslinger
Weapons Creator. The name is Ingrid.
A pleasure to serve you!
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
你好！
我被任命为新的神枪手武器创造者。我叫英格丽德。
很高兴为您服务！

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
It's only been a short while
since I've started working,
But I'll try my best to
assist you.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
虽然我刚开始工作不久，
但我会尽我所能协助你。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
Ahh ... I feel so anxious.
As of now, I'm doing the job of creating a weapon called the Inferno for customers.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
啊...我感到很紧张。
目前，我正在为顾客制造一种名为炼狱的武器。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
The Inferno is the most advanced weapon made in our Guild laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
炼狱是我们公会实验室制造的最先进的武器。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
It features incredible power and range, and an ergonomic design so that it can be held well and significantly minimize kickback when fired.
It's a weapon worthy of being called the ultimate weapon for any Gunslinger.
huff huff...
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
它拥有惊人的威力和射程，并且采用人体工学设计，握持感极佳，能显著减少射击时的后坐力。
这是一把配得上被称为神枪手终极武器的枪械。
呼...呼...

[{0}]
You know quite a lot about it
.....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你对它了解得真多
.....

[Ingrid]

I am the person who designed this weapon..
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
啊。当然~
毕竟我是设计这把武器的人..

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wooow~ That's incredible~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇哦~ 太不可思议了~

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
Ah Oops...
Did I end up bragging?
I'm still nothing compared to Professor Serena.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
啊，糟糕...
我是不是在炫耀了？
和塞蕾娜教授比起来，我还差得远呢。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
Actually, I wanted to become a gunslinger too, but because of my physical shortcomings weak determination, I had to give up.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
其实，我也想成为神枪手，但因为身体条件不足和斗志不够坚定，我不得不放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
While I was applying to become a gunslinger, I was lucky enough to have Professor Serena see my talents, and with her help, I'm where I am now helping with the manufacturing and sales of Gunslinger Weapons
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
在我申请成为神枪手的时候，幸运地得到了塞蕾娜教授的赏识，在她的帮助下，我现在从事神枪手武器的制造和销售工作。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
I'm still remorseful that I wasn't able to become a Gunslinger, but at least my brother, who took the Gunslinger test with me, passed and become one.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
我仍然遗憾自己没能成为神枪手，但至少和我一起参加神枪手考试的哥哥通过了考试，成为了一名神枪手。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
I'm glad that even though I fell, my brother was able to fulfill our dream.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
我很高兴，虽然我自己失败了，但哥哥实现了我们的梦想。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
Haha~ Look at me telling you all these things when you didn't even ask.
Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
哈哈~ 看我说得这么多，你甚至都没问。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it's ok.
You may not have become a Gunslinger, but I think you've become a great person.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。
虽然你没有成为神枪手，但我觉得你成为了一个很棒的人。

scripts.text:
[Ingrid]
Really? Thank you~
I'll try my best.
scripts.translation:
[英格丽德]
真的吗？谢谢~
我会努力的。

scripts.translation:

[N. A]
请学会熟练使用加特林。
那种疯狂的破坏力
绝对会让你在精神上感到愉悦。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, hello?
I'm the Coordinator of
Einbroch Weapon Development.
My name is 'Lab Director'.
Do you need something?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你好？
我是艾音布罗克武器研发的协调员。
我的名字是“实验室总监”。
你需要什么吗？

scripts.text: I need a Special Metal Rod.
scripts.translation: 我需要一根特殊金属棒。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Huh...? Hey, weren't you that guy
who walked out of here with a
Butcher a while ago? How was the
Butcher?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
嗯...？嘿，你之前是不是那个
带着屠夫离开这里的人？
那把屠夫用得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
...... WHAT!? YOU BROKE IT!?
I thought you would be able to
use it well... You disappoint me!!!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
......什么！？你把它弄坏了！？
我还以为你能用好它的...
你让我太失望了！！！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
You betrayed my faith in you!
You traitor! Traitor!! TRAITOR!!!!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你辜负了我对你的信任！
你这个叛徒！叛徒！！叛徒！！！

scripts.text: Explain everything.
scripts.translation: 解释一切。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
...... Whew.
So it was Mr. F. Harrison who
broke it, huh? I'm sorry, I should
not have suspected you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
......呼。
原来是F. 哈里森先生弄坏的啊？
抱歉，我不该怀疑你的。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Lady Celena has the special metal
rod that you want, but the doc is
not in right now, and no one else
knows where it is...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
女士那里有你想要的那根特殊金属棒，
但医生现在不在，
其他人也不知道它在哪里...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I have other research right now
so I can't waste my time looking
for that... Grr... I need the
Elemental Spheres to keep going
with my research...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我现在有其他研究要做，
不能浪费时间去找那个... 哼...
我需要元素球才能继续我的研究...

scripts.text: Make him an offer.
scripts.translation: 向他提出交易。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
An offer? Like what?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
交易？比如什么？

scripts.text: We find things for each other.
scripts.translation: 我们互相帮忙找东西。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Hmm... That sounds good.
Well, according to the offer,
I'll look for the rod for you,
while you find me those
Elemental Spheres.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
嗯...听起来不错。
好吧，按照交易，
我去帮你找那根金属棒，
你帮我找那些元素球。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
30 Poison Sphere, 30 Flare Sphere,
30 Lightning Sphere, 30 Blind
Sphere, or 30 Freezing Sphere.
Find me 30 of each Element.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
30个毒球，30个火球，
30个雷球，30个盲球，
或者30个冰球。
每种元素各找30个给我。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
30 Poison Sphere, 30 Flare Sphere,
30 Lightning Sphere, 30 Blind
Sphere, or 30 Freezing Sphere.
Find me 30 of each Element.
Did you find them?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
30个毒球，30个火球，
30个雷球，30个盲球，
或者30个冰球。
每种元素各找30个给我。
你找到了吗？

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感兴趣

scripts.text: I found 30 Poison Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30个毒球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Flare Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30个火球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Lightning Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30个雷球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Blind Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30个盲球。

scripts.text: I found 30 Freezing Spheres.
scripts.translation: 我找到了30个冰球。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Just bring me whatever type
you could find.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
随便什么属性的都行，
找到什么就带什么来。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Eh? What? Am I the only
person who can't see them?
Bring me more!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
诶？什么？难道只有我
看不见它们吗？
再多带点来！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Wow, you found them all for me!
I had to turn Lady Celena's lab
over to find this rod too.
Let's trade then!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
哇，你全都帮我找到了！
为了找这根枪管，
我不得不把赛蕾娜女士的实验室翻了一遍。
那我们交换吧！

scripts.text:
-You gave the Elemental
Spheres to Research Coordinator and got
the Metal Rod in return.-
scripts.translation: -你将元素球交给了研究协调员，并换回了一根金属枪管。-

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Mr. F. Harrison is very good.
I'm sure he can fix your
Butcher for you.
Well, see you later!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
F. 哈里森先生非常厉害。
我相信他能帮你修好屠夫。
好了，回头见！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Mr. F. Harrison is very good.
I'm sure he can fix your
Butcher for you.
Well, see you later!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
F. 哈里森先生非常厉害。
我相信他能帮你修好屠夫。
好了，回头见！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, hello?
I'm the Coordinator of
Einbroch Weapon Development.
My name is 'Lab Director'.
Do you need something?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你好？
我是艾音布罗克武器研发的协调员。
我的名字是“实验室总监”。
你需要什么吗？

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
If you see Gunslingers around,
please tell them that I have
the latest news on weapons.
If necessary, please send them
here. Heheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你看到神枪手，
请告诉他们我有最新的武器情报。
如果有必要，请把他们引荐到这里。
嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text:
[N. A]
... Destruction... Madness...
Hmm... Attack speed over 180...

[N. A]
Ah, sorry, I'm developing some
new weapons. Please don't
disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，抱歉，我正在研发新武器。
请不要打扰我。

scripts.text: Ask about the 'Drifter'.
scripts.translation: 询问关于“流浪者”的事。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, you heard the news
shortly after the end
of the development eh?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你是在研发刚结束
就听到消息了吗？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
^ff0000Butcher^000000 is the newest development
by us, the Einbroch Firearm Lab.
It is the newest type of Gatling
we have developed. While
^ff0000Drifter^000000 is a good weapon
as well, the ^ff0000Butcher^000000 definitely has
a much stronger firepower!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是我们艾音布罗克枪械实验室的最新研发成果。
它是我们开发出的最新型加特林。虽然
^ff0000流浪者^000000也是一把好枪，但^ff0000屠夫^000000的火力
绝对要强大得多！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Due to its strong firepower,
the Butcher was also dubbed
as the 'Murderer'.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
由于火力强劲，
屠夫也被人称为“杀手”。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
However, even Gunslingers could
have troubles controlling such
a powerful weapon.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
不过，即使是神枪手，
想要控制这么强大的武器
也会感到吃力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you think you can handle it?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你觉得你能驾驭它吗？

scripts.text: I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我不确定...

scripts.text: Of course I can!!
scripts.translation: 我当然可以！！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Butcher^000000 is a weapon that you
can't handle without a strong
will. I'll see you again when
you have enough confidence to
handle this monster.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是一把没有强大意志
就无法驾驭的武器。等你有足够的自信
能驾驭这个怪物时，我们再见面吧。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Aha, how self-confident you
are! However, I see people with
such self-confidence everywhere.
You'll need to prove it...
But how... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈，你真是自信满满啊！不过，
我到处都见过这种自信满满的人。
你得证明一下...
但是怎么证明呢... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Hmmm......

[N. A]
Aha! I got it!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈！我想到了！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Here, bring me ^ff00001000 Orc Claws^000000 and ^ff00001000 Skel Bone^000000.
If you can bring me these items,
I'll let you use the Butcher.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
给我带^ff00001000个兽人指甲^000000和^ff00001000根骷髅骨头^000000来。
如果你能带这些材料给我，
我就让你使用屠夫。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Easy, ain't it? Go and prove
your ability then! Heheheh...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
很简单吧？那就去证明你的实力吧！嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, you're here to learn about
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 eh?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你是来打听^ff0000流浪者^000000的吧？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Drifter^000000 is one of the many
highest-classed weapons developed
by Lady Celena. It's an automatic
Gatling which boasts very high
rate of fire, which is the highest
among all Gunslinger weapons.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000流浪者^000000是赛琳娜女士开发的众多最高级武器之一。它是一把自动加特林机枪，拥有极高的射速，是所有神枪手武器中射速最高的。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Of course, you will need the Skill
to allow you to control Gatlings,
but he who contorls Gatlings well
will receive full aid from the
^ff0000Drifter^000000.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
当然，你需要拥有控制加特林机枪的技能，但那些能熟练操控加特林的人，将能充分发挥^ff0000流浪者^000000的威力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you want to try using the ^ff0000Drifter^000000?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你想试试使用^ff0000流浪者^000000吗？

scripts.text: Um, no.
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text: Yeah!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
If you want to try it out
some time, come back here.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你以后想试试，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Since it's really hard to find
the materials for constructing
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000, we only make them
on requests, and we require those
who want to use the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 to bring
us the materials.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
因为制造^ff0000流浪者^000000的材料很难找到，我们只接受定制订单，并要求想要使用^ff0000流浪者^000000的人自己提供材料。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I'll tell you the materials
needed, just bring them and
we'll construct it for you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我会告诉你需要的材料，只要把它们带过来，我们就为你制造。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
To make a Drifter, we need
70 Steel, 5 Eluniums, 3
Oridecons, 70 Coal, 50 Rusty
Screws, and a fee of
50,000 zeny.
Come back after you found
them all.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
制造一把流浪者，需要70个钢铁、5个铝、3个神之金属、70个煤炭、50个生锈螺丝，以及50,000 Zeny的手续费。
集齐所有材料后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I have news on the latest
weapons but... I guess you're
too busy to hear them.
Maybe next time I guess.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我有最新武器的消息，但...看来你太忙了没空听。
也许下次吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
You are overweight.
Even if I gave you the
weapon, you cannot carry it.
Please clear your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
你超重了。
就算我把武器给你，你也拿不动。
请清理一下你的物品栏。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hmm... Oh?
Ahh...... Eh?

[F. Harrison]
Heheh... Hmm... Huh...?
May I have my Butcher back now?
scripts.translation: 现在可以把屠夫还给我了吗？

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Uh? Oh, umm... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呃？哦，嗯...嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Th-that, huh? Eh... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
那...那个，是吗？呃...嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Ahahahah! I uh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
哈哈哈哈哈！那个...呃...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
That thing! BOOM!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
就是那个东西！轰！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Bam bam! I was gonna fire it!
Yeah!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
砰！砰！我本来想开枪的！
没错！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But it resisted! So I went 'BAM!' with
my hand! MUAHAHAHAH!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
但它抵抗了！所以我用手“砰”地打了一下！穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
And it broke...... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
然后它就坏了...... *抽泣抽泣*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I call myself 'Dr. Everything' and
I wanted to fix it myself, but I
don't seem to have the materials
to fix it... And the materials are
so rare too... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我自称“全能博士”，本想自己修好它，但我似乎没有修理所需的材料... 而且那些材料非常稀有... *抽泣抽泣*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Umm... I'm sorry for breaking
it but... Could you get me the
materials I need for fixing it?
Bring me those items, and I can
fix it, plus I'll modify it for
you! I promise!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嗯... 很抱歉弄坏了它，但是... 你能帮我弄到修理所需的材料吗？
把那些物品带给我，我就能修好它，还会为你改装它！我保证！！

scripts.text:
So please bring me the materials...
*sob sob sob*
scripts.translation:
所以请带给我那些材料...
*抽泣抽泣抽泣*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
I think only Lady Celena can
make those rods......
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是
10个钢，2个铝，
1个神之金属，20个煤炭...
还有一根屠夫用的
特殊金属棒...
我想只有塞琳娜女士
才能制作那些金属棒......

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But first, you'll need to talk
to Lady Celena's assistant, the 'Lab Director',
and ask for his help.
That kid's a bit hysterical, but
she'll be nice help if you talk
to her nicely...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
但首先，你需要去和塞琳娜女士的助手，
也就是“实验室总监”谈谈，
请求他的帮助。
那个小孩有点情绪化，但
如果你好好跟她说话，
她会很有帮助的...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I'm really sorry... Here, I'll
lend you my prized weapon,
'Crimson Bolt'. But make sure
you bring all those materials
to me once you find them all!
Promise me!!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
真的很抱歉... 这里，我把我的
得意武器“鲜红闪电手枪”借给你。
但请务必在找到所有材料后
把它们都带给我！
答应我！！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Talk to the 'Lab Director' for his
assistance on the Rod.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是
10个钢，2个铝，
1个神之金属，20个煤炭...
还有一根屠夫用的
特殊金属棒...
去找“实验室总监”
寻求关于金属棒的协助。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me! I'll get to the repair
right away, please hold on...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！你为我找到了所有材料！
我马上开始修理，请稍等...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me!
... But where's my treasured
'Crimson Bolt'!? I will not fix
your Butcher for you if you don't
bring it back to me!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！你为我找到了所有材料！
... 但是我的宝贝“鲜红闪电手枪”在哪里！？
如果你不把它还给我，
我就不会帮你修理屠夫！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Good thing you found the
Special Metal Rod already.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是
10个钢，2个铝，
1个神之金属，20个煤炭...
还有一根屠夫用的
特殊金属棒...
幸好你已经找到了
那根特殊金属棒。

scripts.text:
-You're overweight already.-
-Come back after dropping some
stuff first.-
scripts.translation:
-你已经超重了。-
-请先丢弃一些物品再来。-

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Whew... Finally it's fixed, thanks
to your effort. I'm very sorry
for breaking it, and thank you
for your effort. I feel guilty
for just fixing it, so I added
some extra power on it. I hope
it'll work nicely for you.
Well, enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呼... 终于修好了，多亏了你的努力。
我很抱歉弄坏了它，也感谢你的付出。
光是修好它让我感到愧疚，所以我额外增加了一些威力。
希望它能让你满意。
那么，尽情使用吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
天哪，我好无聊...
不知道有没有什么有趣的事情...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Oh well... I'll just play with my
beautiful 'Crimson Bolt'.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
算了... 我就玩玩我漂亮的“鲜红闪电手枪”吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
天哪，我好无聊...
不知道有没有什么有趣的事情...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Eh? Are you a Gunslinger?
I haven't seen that weapon
in your hand before...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
咦？你是神枪手吗？
我以前没见过你手里拿着那把武器...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
May I take a look? Please?
C'mon, let me take a look!
I'm bored out of my mind here!
Pleeeeeeeeeeeease~?
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
可以让我看看吗？拜托了！
快让我看看嘛！
我在这里无聊死了！
求求你啦~？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Here...
scripts.translation: 给你...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hah! You think you're the only
one with a cool weapon!? Well
I got my beautiful Crimson Bolt!
Hmph!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
哈！你以为只有你有酷炫的武器吗？
我可是有我漂亮的鲜红闪电手枪！
哼！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Heheh... This is the newest
development by Einbroch Firearms
Lab, the so-called uncontrollable
'Destroyer Butcher', eh?
Interesting... VERY interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嘿嘿... 这是艾音布罗克枪械实验室的最新研发成果，
